title: Morning Star
author: Pierce Brown
summary: The third book of Red Rising. The rebellion against the caste-based rulers of the solar system moves into its final, costly stage, and the hero's cause faces its hardest tests.
readIf: you want a fierce, large-scale conclusion to the first Red Rising trilogy.
skipIf: you want a standalone, because this book depends entirely on the previous ones.

pairings.reason: Another series climax where a rebel leader pays heavily for a war of liberation.
A very different tone, but the same payoff of a long war reaching its decisive battles.
For readers who liked the brutality and want a grittier, more cynical view of fighting men.
